style_lock.style_prefix_verbatim: Style: 8K IMAX. Photorealistic. Cinematography: telephoto compression from 100mm; painterly composed frames with strong negative space; silhouette against contre-jour backlight. Lighting: motivated dawn sun only, one hard source from frame-left, camera on shadow side, mist reads in the beam. Color: teal and amber, low saturation, skin preserved. Camera: cine lens with 1/8 diffusion and 2mm gold streak. 180° shutter motion blur. Skin: pore-level realism. Acting: sleeve moves before hand; breath visible as white plume. Physics: silk falls as silk; blade weight visible. Composition: golden ratio, negative space 60%. Continuity: identity holds across every cut. Technical: 24fps, 8K, no jitter. Audio: environmental SFX only. No music.

modules.SCENE_CONTEXT: EXACT 1 CHARACTER — NO DUPLICATES. Bamboo grove, dawn. Ling Xu stands motionless on wet stone path, back to camera. One continuous 7-second shot. No cuts.
modules.ACTIVE_REFERENCES: @ling_xu — dark indigo robe with pale silver embroidery at collar and cuffs; wide sash tied left; long straight black hair tied high with jade pin; leather-wrapped hilt at left hip; androgynous fine features; mole below left corner of mouth; silver stud left ear-tip; narrow calloused hands. @loc_bamboo_grove_dawn — bamboo grove at dawn (see LOCATION MAP). Take only space and texture. Do not use as starting frame. Do not inherit composition, angle, or grade.

LOCATION MAP
GEO SPATIAL LAYOUT (locked):
— BAMBOO TRUNKS: vertical, spacing 3-5m, frame-fill both sides
— STONE PATH: bisecting frame-center to back, wet flagstone
— STONE BASIN: frame-RIGHT, 1.2m from center
— LING XU: standing on path, CENTER, facing frame-back

modules.FIRST_FRAME_AND_SPATIAL_BLOCKING: SHOT 1 (~1.0s) — a wide that FIXES THE POSITIONS and does nothing else: Ling Xu planted at center of the stone path, back to camera, sleeves hanging still, left hand resting on the sword hilt. Stone basin at frame-right holding the fallen pine-needle cluster on still water. Bamboo trunks receding into mist on both sides. No camera move on frame one. No action beat.
modules.FORMAT_MODE: Single continuous take. Total duration: 7 seconds. Real time. No cuts. No speed ramps.
modules.OPTICS: 100mm telephoto. Camera height 1.6m at chest height of the subject seen from behind. Camera distance to subject: 6.5m. Deep enough to hold Ling Xu and one out-of-focus foreground bamboo trunk; background bamboo falls into mist.
modules.CAMERA: Locked-off tripod. Zero motion — no drift, no shake, no breathing, no stabilization float. Angle, elevation, distance frozen. All motion comes from the scene itself. Constraints: No pan. No tilt. No push. No handheld drift.
modules.ACTION_TIMING:
0.0–2.0s — Room holds. Ling Xu perfectly still, back to camera. Mist drifts slowly across the beam of amber light from frame-left.
2.0–4.0s — One breath cycle: white plume rises from Ling Xu's mouth over ~1.5s, drifts frame-right, dissipates.
4.0–5.5s — Sleeve on left arm settles imperceptibly; the hilt hand relaxes one fingertip and returns.
5.5–7.0s — Held stillness resumes; final frame identical to opening frame.
modules.PHYSICS: Silk sleeve hangs with real weight, no wind sway; the breath plume respects the amber beam (white becomes gold in the beam, disperses in the shade); mist drifts at a walking pace not a wind pace; the fallen pine leaf floats without submerging.
modules.LIGHTING: One hard source: dawn amber sun from frame-LEFT at 30° elevation. Ling Xu backlit and rim-lit — jade pin catches an amber highlight, cheekbone edge visible. Camera side is in shadow — no fill. Path in front two stops darker than the beam. Mist reads in the beam.
modules.AUDIO: Diegetic only — bamboo trunks knocking hollowly at ~0.5Hz, distant water drip on stone every 3-4s, silk sleeve friction on the sleeve settle at ~4.5s, breath work close mic during the exhale plume 2.0-3.5s. Ling Xu does not speak. Mix: ambient underneath breath. No music.
modules.CHARACTER_ACTING: LING XU — Emotional state: holding the ground of a decision already made. What they want in this moment: to make the standing itself into the answer. What they are hiding: the decision was made against a teacher's wish. Dominant body rhythm: planted, vertical, no sway. Visible habits: breath visible as white plume; sleeve moves before hand; gaze reads objects before people. What changes across the shot: nothing changes — the stillness is the point. INNER (unspoken): I have already left.
modules.STYLE: Style: 8K IMAX. Photorealistic. Cinematography: telephoto compression from 100mm; painterly composed frames with strong negative space; silhouette against contre-jour backlight. Lighting: motivated dawn sun only, one hard source from frame-left, camera on shadow side, mist reads in the beam. Color: teal and amber, low saturation, skin preserved. Camera: cine lens with 1/8 diffusion and 2mm gold streak. 180° shutter motion blur. Skin: pore-level realism. Acting: sleeve moves before hand; breath visible as white plume. Physics: silk falls as silk. Composition: golden ratio, negative space 60%. Continuity: identity holds across every cut. Technical: 24fps, 8K, no jitter. Audio: environmental SFX only. No music.
modules.QUALITY: 8K detail. Pore-level skin. No jitter. No flicker. 1 face remains exactly Ling Xu's reference. Sharpness anchors: jade pin edge stable; sword hilt leather grain holds; wet stone specular stable under amber beam.
modules.POSITIVE_CONSTRAINTS: Exactly 1 person in the bamboo grove — no one else, no birds, no visible wildlife. Exactly 1 jade pin in the hair — never removed, never repositioned, catches amber rim light. Exactly 1 sword at left hip, sheathed — never drawn. Exactly 1 fallen pine-needle cluster on the basin water — never multiplied. Camera stays on the path's LEFT side for all seven seconds. Photoreal. NON-IP. 2.39:1. 7s. SFX only. NO CGI. Cinematic.
